column1: # Immutable merge SHA<TAB>reviewed signed source SHA<TAB>source signer email.
# This ledger is only for protected-history squash merges whose source commit
# carried a valid @mail.build sign-off but whose immutable GitHub merge commit
# lost the trailer. Additions require a signed, reviewed commit; wildcards and
# short SHAs are rejected by scripts/check-commit-signoff.sh.
